Chapter 1221 - 31: Lin Yuan’S Future Timeline (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 1221: Chapter 31: Lin Yuan’s Future Timeline (Please Subscribe)_2

It is precisely the thirteen-tier weapon, the Sky Void Tripod.

The rules of the great Dao contained within the cauldron operate, and Lin Yuan has different insights each time he comprehends them.

"A thirteen-tier weapon..."

Lin Yuan watched the slowly rotating and floating Sky Void Tripod. Even in the six great Ancient Countries of the Origin World, to exchange for a thirteen-tier weapon, a thousand billion merits would be needed.

And the exchanged thirteen-tier weapons can only be comprehended for ten thousand years. After ten thousand years, they must be returned.

"This tripod..."

Lin Yuan observed the floating small tripod, vaguely looking toward the deepest parts, realizing that the foundation of this thirteen-tier weapon was not the myriad rules, but the subtle timelines within.

"Timelines?"

Lin Yuan’s heart trembled slightly, vaguely realizing that perhaps he had truly come into contact with the domain of thirteen-tier time-life entities.

"The future..."

Lin Yuan, by observing the timelines of this small tripod, vaguely saw blurred images.

Under a desolate starry sky, a young man raised his hand, his gaze indifferent, urging the Sky Void Tripod, blasting it towards an unknown special place.

Under the terrifying might of the Sky Void Tripod, that special place crumbled inch by inch, the ’soul’ of the special place laughing madly, saying ’The great time-life entity will avenge me’, and then totally obliterated.

After destroying a special place, the young man’s expression changed slightly, looking in a certain direction.

Most regions in the image were very blurry, and Lin Yuan could only confirm that the young man seemed to have sensed something.

Finally, the young man voluntarily destroyed his physical body and soul, even abandoning the Sky Void Tripod, disappearing completely into the void.

...

The image ended.

Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

Without a doubt.

The image should depict the future.

As for the young man in the image urging the Sky Void Tripod, it was indeed Lin Yuan.

But why his future self would, at all costs, urge the Sky Void Tripod and completely destroy a special place, Lin Yuan did not understand.

The special places in the Chaos Void are basically related to thirteen-tier time-life entities. Completely destroying a special place would surely provoke the time-life entity behind it.

In the final moments of the image, the young man voluntarily obliterated his physical body and soul, presumably due to the arrival of a time-life entity.

Lin Yuan was unsure how many years it would be in the future for him in the image, but based on his growth speed, even in just a few thousand years, his strength should be at the pinnacle below the thirteen tiers, where so-called Invincible Great Saints, Strongest Venerables, should pose no threat in front of him thousands of years later.

Even under such circumstances, choosing to voluntarily obliterate everything could only be due to a time-life entity’s threat.

Lin Yuan knew himself well, obliterating his physical body, soul, mind, and will in the Chaos Void didn’t mean complete death to him, it was just losing a way out, while the self in the Origin World was living just fine.

"With my character, I shouldn’t be so impulsive, not only forcefully urging the Sky Void Tripod but also completely destroying a special place related to thirteen-tier time-life entities?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself, urging the Sky Void Tripod would attract the gaze of this thirteen-tier weapon’s owner, and destroying a special place was tantamount to thoroughly offending a thirteen-tier time-life entity.

The costs and consequences were not something Lin Yuan could bear, unless he had already become a time-life entity, but at that time voluntarily obliterating all his physical body and soul meant Lin Yuan was not yet a match for the thirteen tiers.

"Could it be due to some great feud?"

Lin Yuan thought in his heart: "Human civilization tribe?"

According to Lin Yuan’s speculation, he wandered alone without many friends, the only possible great feud could be with the human civilization tribe.

His future self, at the risk of abandoning all foundations in the Chaos Void, aimed to completely destroy that special place, evidently showing irreconcilable hatred between the two.

Perhaps it was not just hatred, but the soul of that special place had learned one of his secrets, prompting his future self to take action?

Various possibilities appeared in Lin Yuan’s mind.

"Unfortunately, I’m not yet a time-life entity. Even though I could view a fragment of future imagery, it’s hard to infer specific information..."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

The information revealed in the current image was too limited, most of the regions were extremely blurry, and even the special place he destroyed was incredibly vague, only faintly perceiving the gaze of other special places in the distant background.

If one were truly a time-life entity, they could carefully view all details of this future timeline, understanding the reason and outcome, ultimately thinking of a response, or choosing whether to follow this timeline or not.

Thirteen-tier time-life entities have the ability to choose their future, for example, upon seeing a future timeline they are dissatisfied with, they can completely terminate the trajectory of that timeline from a certain node.

Conflicts between thirteen-tier time-life entities mainly depend on how many timeline trajectories they can view, the more powerful the thirteen-tier time-life entity, the more and farther future timelines they can see, thus having greater advantages in same-tier conflicts.

For example, at certain future key nodes, sudden clashes between two thirteen-tier life forms occur without any signs, without any grudges.

It is estimated that the future each time-life entity desired came into conflict, fighting to correct and redirecting the future toward their desired direction.

...

Lin Yuan wanted to continue watching future timelines through the Sky Void Tripod, but suddenly felt a certain pain in his soul, immediately stopping his observation.

Future timelines belonged to the realm of the thirteen tiers, and Lin Yuan, using the Sky Void Tripod, barely touched upon them but with severe limitations, being unable to watch continuously.

"Forget it."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts.

The past is set, the future is undefined.

Every moment can produce countless futures, and even a thirteen-tier time-life entity cannot view all future timelines.

Perhaps the future image Lin Yuan just saw would never occur, it was only an infinitesimal possible trajectory?

"No matter what, moving forward, it’s best to remain as low-profile as possible and refrain from associating with those special places." Lin Yuan thought to himself, although even if abandoning everything in the Chaos Void wouldn’t cause an irreversible impact, it would still be a great loss.

Best not to let go if possible.

In Lin Yuan’s planned trajectory, before stepping into the thirteen tiers, no significant commotion would be stirred.

...

Origin World.

Within the precious land.

As time passed.

The Spirit Prison Venerable of the Da Ling Ancient Country also approached Lin Yuan, wanting to trade the forty-five precious lands his country occupied and refined with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Compared to the Xuanyin Ancient Country, the demands from the Da Ling Ancient Country were even more excessive, demanding a direct transfer of the ten trillion-year ownership of this precious land.

This meant that even if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country ultimately seized this precious land, within ten trillion years, it would have no relation to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and all its unique treasures would belong to the Da Ling Ancient Country.

"Galaxy Venerate, my Da Ling Ancient Country occupies and refines forty-five core pillars. Once you acquire them, you will surpass the Da Fu Ancient Country in one leap," said the Spirit Prison Venerable.

So far, the most likely candidates to seize this precious land were the Da Fu Ancient Country and the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, followed by the Barbaric Wilderness Country.

As for the remaining three great Ancient Countries, they basically have no hope.

"I’ll consider it," Lin Yuan did not directly reject.

"Alright," the Spirit Prison Venerable nodded, if Lin Yuan agreed immediately, he would instead feel uneasy.

After the Spirit Prison Venerable left.

Red Flame Venerable looked at Lin Yuan and said, "Both the Xuanyin Ancient Country and the Da Ling Ancient Country have approached us, but the Thunderclap Ancient Country has never come. Estimating they have wholly leaned towards the Da Fu Ancient Country."

Red Flame Venerable’s expression was heavy.

The Thunderclap Ancient Country occupies and refines thirty-eight core pillars, all aligning with the Da Fu Ancient Country, equivalent to the latter’s core pillar count surpassing a hundred.

"Never mind."

"Let’s wait and see," Lin Yuan’s tone was calm.

Time continued to pass.

On this very day, a peculiar wave swept through various parts of the precious land.

The Peak Venerables of the great Ancient Countries together looked towards the source of the wave—

The second giant core pillar emerged.
